mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness reducing corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate above 2.5% triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of FEDFUNDS > 2.5% instances, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of INDPRO increase periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,200,000 units (HOUST < 1200.0), it signals weak consumer demand for housing and reduced economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of HOUST < 1200.0 instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in private employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During slow GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200.0) triggers negative feedback in consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 < 1.5% growth periods, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of HOUST < 1200.0 instances, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.
